message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Notify Release

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      tag_name:
        description: 'Published release tag'
        required: true
        type: string
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag_name:
        description: 'Published release tag (empty = nearest tag on selected ref)'
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  notify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Cloning repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      
      - name: Get Latest Tag
        id: get_tag
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.tag_name }}
        run: |
          LATEST_TAG="$RELEASE_TAG"
          if [ -z "$LATEST_TAG" ]; then
            LATEST_TAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          fi
          git check-ref-format "refs/tags/$LATEST_TAG"
          
          if [ -z "$LATEST_TAG" ]; then
            echo "No tags found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "LATEST_TAG=$LATEST_TAG" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "Latest tag: $LATEST_TAG"
          
      - name: Get Release Information
        id: get_release
        env:
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          RELEASE_DATA=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/releases/tags/$LATEST_TAG")
          
          echo "$RELEASE_DATA" | jq -r '.body' > release_notes.txt
          
          echo "FORMATTED_NOTES<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          cat release_notes.txt >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          
          echo "Release notes fetched successfully"

      - name: Get All Release Assets
        id: get_assets
        env:
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/releases/tags/$LATEST_TAG" -o release.json
          
          bytes_to_hr() {
            awk -v size="$1" 'BEGIN{
              split("B KB MB GB", unit);
              for (i=1; size>=1024 && i<4; i++) size/=1024;
              printf "%.2f %s", size, unit[i]
            }'
          }
          
          echo "Processing assets..."
          
          # Initialize all asset variables
          APK_UNIVERSAL=""
          APK_ARM64=""
          APK_ARM32=""
          APK_X86=""
          WINDOWS_SETUP=""
          WINDOWS_PORTABLE=""
          LINUX_DEB=""
          LINUX_RPM=""
          LINUX_FLATPAK=""
          LINUX_PORTABLE=""
          
          # Parse each asset
          while IFS= read -r line; do
            ASSET_URL=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.browser_download_url')
            ASSET_SIZE=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.size')
            FILE_NAME=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.name')
            SIZE_HR=$(bytes_to_hr "$ASSET_SIZE")
            
            echo "Found asset: $FILE_NAME"
            
            # Categorize assets
            case "$FILE_NAME" in
              *app-release.apk* | *universal*.apk)
                APK_UNIVERSAL="[Universal APK]($ASSET_URL) \`$SIZE_HR\`"
                ;;
              *arm64-v8a*.apk)
                APK_ARM64="[ARM64 APK]($ASSET_URL) \`$SIZE_HR\`"
                ;;
              *armeabi-v7a*.apk)
                APK_ARM32="[ARM32 APK]($ASSET_URL) \`$SIZE_HR\`"
                ;;
              *x86_64*.apk)
                APK_X86="[x86_64 APK]($ASSET_URL) \`$SIZE_HR\`"
                ;;
              *.exe)
                WINDOWS_SETUP="[Windows Installer]($ASSET_URL) \`$SIZE_HR\`"
                ;;
              *.zip)
                LINUX_PORTABLE="[Linux Portable]($ASSET_URL) \`$SIZE_HR\`"
                ;;
            esac
          done < <(jq -c '.assets[]' release.json)
          
          # Export all variables to GitHub ENV
          echo "APK_UNIVERSAL=$APK_UNIVERSAL" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "APK_ARM64=$APK_ARM64" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "APK_ARM32=$APK_ARM32" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "APK_X86=$APK_X86" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "WINDOWS_SETUP=$WINDOWS_SETUP" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "WINDOWS_PORTABLE=$WINDOWS_PORTABLE" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "LINUX_DEB=$LINUX_DEB" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "LINUX_RPM=$LINUX_RPM" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "LINUX_FLATPAK=$LINUX_FLATPAK" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "LINUX_PORTABLE=$LINUX_PORTABLE" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          
          echo "Assets processed successfully"

      - name: Format Release Notes for Discord
        run: |
          MAX=5
      
          format_section () {
            TITLE="$1"
            CONTENT="$2"
          
            TOTAL=$(echo "$CONTENT" | grep -c "^•" || echo 0)
            SHOWN=$(echo "$CONTENT" | grep "^•" | head -n $MAX)
          
            if [ "$TOTAL" -gt 0 ]; then
              echo "**$TITLE**"
              echo "$SHOWN"
          
              if [ "$TOTAL" -gt "$MAX" ]; then
                EXTRA=$((TOTAL - MAX))
                echo "*+ $EXTRA more commits*"
              fi
          
              # 🔽 FORCE blank line after every category
              echo ""
            fi
          }

      
          NOTES=$(cat release_notes.txt | \
            sed -E 's/### (.*)/\n**\1**\n/g' | \
            sed -E 's|\* \[([a-f0-9]+)\]\((https://github.com/[^)]+)\): (.*)|• [\1](\2) \3|g' | \
            sed 's/||//g' | sed 's/---.*//g')
      
          FEATURES=$(echo "$NOTES" | sed -n '/\*\*.*New Features/,/\*\*[^N]/p')
          FIXES=$(echo "$NOTES" | sed -n '/\*\*.*Bug Fixes/,/\*\*[^B]/p')
          REFACTORS=$(echo "$NOTES" | sed -n '/\*\*.*Refactors/,/\*\*[^R]/p')
          STYLE=$(echo "$NOTES" | sed -n '/\*\*.*Style/,/\*\*[^S]/p')
          PERF=$(echo "$NOTES" | sed -n '/\*\*.*Performance/,/\*\*[^P]/p')
          CHORES=$(echo "$NOTES" | sed -n '/\*\*.*Chores/,/\*\*[^C]/p')
      
          DISCORD_NOTES=""

          section=$(format_section "✨ New Features" "$FEATURES")
          [ -n "$section" ] && DISCORD_NOTES+="$section"$'\n\n'

          section=$(format_section "🐛 Bug Fixes" "$FIXES")
          [ -n "$section" ] && DISCORD_NOTES+="$section"$'\n\n'

          section=$(format_section "🔧 Refactors" "$REFACTORS")
          [ -n "$section" ] && DISCORD_NOTES+="$section"$'\n\n'

          section=$(format_section "🎨 Style Changes" "$STYLE")
          [ -n "$section" ] && DISCORD_NOTES+="$section"$'\n\n'

          section=$(format_section "⚡ Performance" "$PERF")
          [ -n "$section" ] && DISCORD_NOTES+="$section"$'\n\n'

          section=$(format_section "🧹 Chores" "$CHORES")
          [ -n "$section" ] && DISCORD_NOTES+="$section"$'\n\n'
      
          DISCORD_NOTES+="\n📋 [View full changelog on GitHub](https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/releases/tag/$LATEST_TAG)"
      
          echo "DISCORD_NOTES<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo -e "$DISCORD_NOTES" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV


      - name: Send Release Announcement to Discord
        env:
          DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.DISCORD_WEBHOOK }}
        run: |
          # Determine role mention based on release type
          if [[ "${{ env.LATEST_TAG }}" == *alpha* ]]; then
            role_mention=""   # Replace with Alpha role ID <@&YOUR_ALPHA_ROLE_ID>
          elif [[ "${{ env.LATEST_TAG }}" == *beta* ]]; then
            role_mention=""   # Replace with Beta role ID <@&YOUR_Beta_ROLE_ID>
          else
            role_mention="<@&1354536001825145003>"   # Replace with stable role ID <@&YOUR_stable_ROLE_ID>
          fi
          
          # Set color based on release type
          if [[ "${{ env.LATEST_TAG }}" == *alpha* ]]; then
            color=15844367  # Orange
          elif [[ "${{ env.LATEST_TAG }}" == *beta* ]]; then
            color=15105570  # Gold
          else
            color=1754421   # Green
          fi
          
          # Create Discord embed
          discord_data=$(jq -nc \
            --arg role "$role_mention" \
            --arg title "🚀 New Release: $LATEST_TAG" \
            --arg description "$DISCORD_NOTES" \
            --arg footer "AnimeStream • $(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)" \
            --arg timestamp "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z)" \
            --argjson color "$color" \
            --arg url "https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/releases/tag/$LATEST_TAG" \
            '{"content":$role,"embeds":[{"title":$title,"description":$description,"color":$color,"url":$url,"footer":{"text":$footer},"timestamp":$timestamp}]}')
          
          # Send to Discord
          curl -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -X POST \
            -d "$discord_data" \
            "$DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL"
          
          echo "✅ Release announcement sent to Discord"

      - name: Send Download Links to Discord
        env:
          DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.DISCORD_WEBHOOK }}
        run: |
          # Build download message with proper newlines
          MESSAGE="## 📦 **Download ${{ env.LATEST_TAG }}**"$'\n\n'
          
          # Android Section
          if [ -n "$APK_UNIVERSAL" ] || [ -n "$APK_ARM64" ] || [ -n "$APK_ARM32" ] || [ -n "$APK_X86" ]; then
            MESSAGE="${MESSAGE}**📱 Android**"$'\n'
            [ -n "$APK_UNIVERSAL" ] && MESSAGE="${MESSAGE}$APK_UNIVERSAL"$'\n'
            [ -n "$APK_ARM64" ] && MESSAGE="${MESSAGE}$APK_ARM64"$'\n'
            [ -n "$APK_ARM32" ] && MESSAGE="${MESSAGE}$APK_ARM32"$'\n'
            [ -n "$APK_X86" ] && MESSAGE="${MESSAGE}$APK_X86"$'\n'
            MESSAGE="${MESSAGE}"$'\n'
          fi
          
          # Windows Section
          if [ -n "$WINDOWS_SETUP" ] || [ -n "$WINDOWS_PORTABLE" ]; then
            MESSAGE="${MESSAGE}**🪟 Windows**"$'\n'
            [ -n "$WINDOWS_SETUP" ] && MESSAGE="${MESSAGE}$WINDOWS_SETUP"$'\n'
            [ -n "$WINDOWS_PORTABLE" ] && MESSAGE="${MESSAGE}$WINDOWS_PORTABLE"$'\n'
            MESSAGE="${MESSAGE}"$'\n'
          fi
          
          # Linux Section
          if [ -n "$LINUX_DEB" ] || [ -n "$LINUX_RPM" ] || [ -n "$LINUX_FLATPAK" ] || [ -n "$LINUX_PORTABLE" ]; then
            MESSAGE="${MESSAGE}**🐧 Linux**"$'\n'
            [ -n "$LINUX_DEB" ] && MESSAGE="${MESSAGE}$LINUX_DEB"$'\n'
            [ -n "$LINUX_RPM" ] && MESSAGE="${MESSAGE}$LINUX_RPM"$'\n'
            [ -n "$LINUX_FLATPAK" ] && MESSAGE="${MESSAGE}$LINUX_FLATPAK"$'\n'
            [ -n "$LINUX_PORTABLE" ] && MESSAGE="${MESSAGE}$LINUX_PORTABLE"$'\n'
            MESSAGE="${MESSAGE}"$'\n'
          fi
          
          # Add footer
          MESSAGE="${MESSAGE}[📋 View all assets on GitHub](https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/releases/tag/$LATEST_TAG)"
          
          # Create and send Discord message
          PAYLOAD=$(jq -n --arg content "$MESSAGE" '{"content":$content}')
          
          curl -X POST "$DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$PAYLOAD"
          
          echo "✅ Download links sent to Discord"

      - name: Send Summary
        run: |
          echo "══════════════════════════════════════════"
          echo "✅ Release notification completed!"
          echo "═════════════════════════════════════════"
          echo "📋 Release: ${{ env.LATEST_TAG }}"
          echo "📦 Assets sent to Discord:"
          [ -n "$APK_UNIVERSAL" ] && echo "   ✓ Android APKs"
          [ -n "$WINDOWS_SETUP" ] && echo "   ✓ Windows builds"
          [ -n "$LINUX_DEB" ] && echo "   ✓ Linux packages"
          echo "🔗 Release: https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/releases/tag/${{ env.LATEST_TAG }}"
          echo "═════════════════════════════════════════"
",
  "rationale": "The workflow is a single-job release notification with no dependency installation, matrix, schedule, or test suite, so cache, test-selection, matrix fail-fast, and schedule optimizations do not apply. The job currently relies on GitHub's default 360-minute timeout. Repository history shows successful runs complete in roughly 10 seconds, satisfying the P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT precondition of representative successful-duration history. Adding an explicit 30-minute job timeout bounds runaway consumption (for example, a hung GitHub API or Discord webhook call) with ample operational headroom, without removing any step, changing coverage, adding privileges, secrets, or new network access.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}
